system.description:
Effects

Intimate Knowledge: Generally, effects that can be done to other people can be done to the mage by themselves at 1 sphere rank lower than usual due to their innate knowledge of their own pattern and self.

Heal: From level 2 onwards the caster starts to heal at a cost of 1 success spent on potency per superficial damage and 2 (and 1 quintessence) per aggravated.
